requirements.title: 两种读写锁在重入获取前拒绝除 -1 外的负阻塞超时
requirements.quote: Reject negative blocking timeouts other than `-1` before reentrant acquisition in `ReadWriteLock` and `SoftReadWriteLock`.

requirements.title: 无效调用不得改变锁深度
requirements.quote: Invalid calls must not change lock depth.

requirements.title: 保留 -1 表示的无限等待
requirements.quote: Preserve unlimited waits and nonblocking acquisition.

requirements.title: 保留非阻塞获取及其超时处理行为
requirements.quote: Preserve unlimited waits and filelock’s nonblocking timeout behavior, consistent with #755.
